verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim ships official Python namespace packages installable via pip, and supports Python-first workflows and standalone scripts for controlling robots and environments. That is a first-party SDK in one language only, and nothing shows typed bindings or coverage of the full platform surface. missing for 10: TypeScript SDK, Go SDK, C++ SDK, evidence of typed interfaces, evidence of full-surface API coverage, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against official, typed SDKs in multiple languages (Python, TypeScript, Go, C++) that cover the platform's full surface

citations.quote: Isaac Sim provides several Python namespace packages that allow you to compose an Isaac Sim app by parts using a Python package manager (for example: pip).
Python Environment Use pip or conda for Python-first workflows
Write your first standalone script to control robots and environments.
